learning_experiences: kutambua maneno yanayotumiwa katika maamkuzi mbalimbali ya nyakati za siku (habari ya asubuhi, habari ya mchana, Habari ya jioni, siku njema) kutoka kwenye chati, vitabu, kadi maneno, mti maneno, michoro, picha au vifaa vya kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutazama picha za watu wakisalimiana na kuagana akishirikiana na wenzake kujadili picha hizo,
kutazama video inayoonyesha watu wakitumia maamkuzi na maagano ya nyakati za siku,
kuigiza na mwenzake maamkuzi na maagano mbalimbali.
key_inquiry_questions: Tunaamkuana vipi wakati wa asubuhi, mchana na jioni?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki kikamilifu katika kazi ya kikundi na kujadiliana kuhusu maamkuzi na maagano ya nyakati za siku.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutazama watu wakisalimiana na kuagana.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoigiza ipasavyo maamkuzi na maagano ya nyakati mbalimbali.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapojadili picha za watu wanaoamkuana na kuagana.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapowaamkua wengine kwa heshima.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowaamkua na kuwaaga wenzake.
Amani: mwanafunzi anapowaamkua na kuwaaga wenzake.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapojumuika na wenzake katika kuigiza maamkuzi na maagano darasani, shuleni na katika mazingira yake.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya maamkuzi na maagano aliyojifunza katika somo la Kiwahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua maamkuzi na maagano ya nyakati za siku
kuamkua na kuitikia maamkuzi na maagano ya nyakati za siku

skills.name: Tumia maamkuzi na maagano yafaayo na majibu yake
skills.mastery: Chooses the greeting or farewell that fits who is met (a friend, an elder, a group), the time of day and whether arriving or leaving, and gives the right reply (Hujambo? Sijambo; Shikamoo, Marahaba; Hamjambo? Hatujambo), in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: The first greetings and farewells of Grade 1 come before the greetings of the times of day.
Words of courtesy of Grade 1.

misconceptions.error: Answers a greeting with the same greeting (Hujambo? Hujambo!) instead of its reply.
misconceptions.cause: The child hears the greeting as a sound to echo, as with "Hello" in English; the question-and-answer pair has not been learnt.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki anakusalimu: "Hujambo?" Unajibu nini?" with "Hujambo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act it as a ball game: the greeting is thrown, the reply is caught; the two words are on two different cards.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukiulizwa "Hujambo?" unajibu "Sijambo," maana yake sina tatizo.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Greets an elder with a peer or Sheng greeting (Mambo! Sasa!) instead of Shikamoo.
misconceptions.cause: Mambo and Sasa are what the child hears most among children and on the street; he has not been taught that an elder is greeted differently.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unamwona babu njiani. Unamsalimu vipi?" with "Mambo babu!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort picture cards of people (babu, rafiki, mwalimu) into two piles: Shikamoo and Hujambo.
misconceptions.feedback: Mzee husalimiwa kwa heshima: Shikamoo babu!
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives the elder's reply to the child's greeting the wrong way round (the elder says Shikamoo, or the child says Marahaba).

example.question: Mtoto anamsalimu bibi: "Shikamoo bibi!" Bibi anajibu nini?

misconceptions.cause: Both words are heard together and the child does not yet know which belongs to the young person and which to the elder.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mtoto anamsalimu bibi: "Shikamoo bibi!" Bibi anajibu nini?" with "Shikamoo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Role-play with a hat for the elder: only the one with the hat may say Marahaba.
misconceptions.feedback: Mtoto anasema Shikamoo; mzee anajibu Marahaba.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the greeting of another time of day.

example.question: Mnakutana na mwalimu mchana baada ya chakula. Unamsalimu vipi?

misconceptions.cause: The child learnt one greeting as a set phrase and uses it at every hour.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mnakutana na mwalimu mchana baada ya chakula. Unamsalimu vipi?" with "Habari za asubuhi mwalimu!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: A clock or sun chart: asubuhi, mchana, jioni, usiku; the child moves the arrow and says the greeting for that time.
misconceptions.feedback: Salamu hufuata wakati: Habari za mchana mwalimu!
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a greeting when leaving, or a farewell when arriving.

example.question: Unaondoka shuleni jioni. Unamuaga mwalimu vipi?

misconceptions.cause: Greeting and farewell words are learnt on one chart and the child mixes the two columns.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unaondoka shuleni jioni. Unamuaga mwalimu vipi?" with "Hujambo mwalimu!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act out a door: walk in and greet, walk out and say goodbye.
misconceptions.feedback: Unapoondoka unaaga: Kwaheri mwalimu, tutaonana kesho!
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Greets a group with the singular greeting (Hujambo?) or answers for a group with Sijambo.

example.question: Mwalimu anaingia darasani na kusema: "Hamjambo wanafunzi?" Darasa linajibu nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child knows one pair only; the plural forms hamjambo/hatujambo follow the person marker (m-, tu-), which has not been noticed.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anaingia darasani na kusema: "Hamjambo wanafunzi?" Darasa linajibu nini?" with "Sijambo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Greet one child, then the whole row; show that the word changes with one or many.
misconceptions.feedback: Watu wengi hujibu "Hatujambo."
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno 31 - 34 na kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa akiwa peke yake, au na wenzake,
kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa ipasavyo katika mawasiliano,
kutabiri ujumbe wa kifungu kwa kutazama picha kwenye kitabu, vifaa vya kidijitali au chati akiwa na wenzake,
kutabiri kitakachotokea katika hadithi akizingatia picha kwenye kifungu akishirikiana na wenzake,
kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu akiwa na wenzake,
kuthibitisha utabiri wake kuhusu hadithi baada ya kuisoma,
kueleza mafunzo yanayotokana na kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu akishirikiana na wenzake,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
key_inquiry_questions: Kusoma kifungu ili ufahamu ujumbe unafanya nini?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi na kuchangia katika kutambua msamiati, kutabiri na kujibu maswali.
Uwazaji wa kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotoa utabiri kutokana na picha na kuchangia katika kujibu maswali.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kijiditali kusoma hadithi na kutazama picha.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kwa kikundi kujadiliana.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wengine katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapoeleza mafunzo kutokana na kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kusoma hadithi na pia kujadili picha ukakamavu wake unaimarika.
Utunzaji na matumizi yafaayo ya vitu vinavyopatikana shuleni: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya kusoma kwa ufahamu na aliyojifunza katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English Language Activitie na Indigenous Language Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua msamiati kuhusu suala lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu
kutabiri yatakayotokea katika kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu kwa kuzingatia picha
kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu
kueleza mafunzo yanayotokana na kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu
kuchangamkia kusoma vifungu vya ufahamu ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma

skills.name: Soma kifungu chepesi: msamiati, ujumbe, kutabiri na mafunzo
skills.mastery: Reads a short passage on shuleni, gives the meaning of a theme word from the sentence around it, says the message, predicts what happens next from the clues in the picture and says the lesson, answering from the passage and not from his own life, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Answering questions about a very short passage in Grade 1 comes first.
Reading readiness of Grade 1: holding the book and reading left to right.

misconceptions.error: Gives "kukaribisha" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Leo ni siku ya kwanza ya Neema shuleni. Mwalimu alimkaribisha darasani kwa tabasamu. Neema alipata rafiki mpya anayeitwa Amani." Neno "kukaribisha" lina maana gani?

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Soma: "Leo ni siku ya kwanza ya Neema shuleni. Mwalimu alimkaribisha darasani kwa tabasamu. Neema alipata rafiki mpya anayeitwa Amani." Neno "kukaribisha" lina maana gani?" with "kukasirisha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
misconceptions.feedback: Katika kifungu, "kukaribisha" ni kumpokea mtu kwa furaha.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Shule ni mahali pazuri pa kupata marafiki na kujifunza.

misconceptions.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Neema alipata rafiki." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
misconceptions.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Shule ni mahali pazuri pa kupata marafiki na kujifunza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for, without looking at the picture.

example.question: Picha inaonyesha kengele ikilia na watoto wakitoka nje. Nini kitatokea?

misconceptions.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha kengele ikilia na watoto wakitoka nje. Nini kitatokea?" with "Watalala darasani." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the clue words and point at the picture; the guess must fit them.
misconceptions.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za picha na za kifungu: Wataenda kucheza wakati wa mapumziko.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kuwakaribisha wanafunzi wapya kwa upendo.

misconceptions.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Mwalimu alitabasamu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
misconceptions.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kuwakaribisha wanafunzi wapya kwa upendo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.

example.question: Rafiki mpya wa Neema anaitwa nani?

misconceptions.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki mpya wa Neema anaitwa nani?" with "Rafiki yangu anaitwa Juma." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu liko kwenye kifungu: Amani
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

content_topics: Sentensi: Maumbo yanayofaa, kutoacha nafasi baina ya herufi katika neno, kuacha nafasi kati ya neno lingine),
learning_experiences: kutambua hati nadhifu kwenye kitabu, chati au kifaa cha kidijitali akiwa na wenzake,
kujadili na wenzake kuhusu hati nadhifu kwenye kitabu, chati au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kuandika sentensi fupi kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia hati nadhifu,
kuwasilisha darasani sentensi zake ili wenzake wamtolee maoni,
kumwandikia mzazi au mlezi sentensi fupi kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia hati nadhifu.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni mambo gani unayozingatia wakati wa kuandika?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapojadiliana na wenzake kuhusu hati nadhifu. Pia, anaposhiriki kikamilifu kuandika akiwa na wenzake katika kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotambua hati nadhifu katika kifaa cha kidijitali.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoandika akizingatia hati nadhifu.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuheshimu maoni yao.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuwathamini wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli ya kuandika.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapojadili na wenzake kuhusu hati nadhifu uwezo wake wa uandishi bora unakuzwa.
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi azingatie hatua za kiusalama anapotambua hati nadhifu kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya kuandika kwa hati nadhifu anayojifunza katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English Language Activitie na Indigenous Language Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua hati nadhifu katika sentensi
kuandika sentensi akizingatia hati nadhifu
kufurahia kuandika akizingatia hati nadhifu

skills.name: Andika kifungu kwa hati nadhifu
skills.mastery: Writes a passage of about 15 words in neat handwriting: letters well formed and on the line, space between words, through the steps to a clean copy, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Neat writing of words in Grade 1 comes before neat sentences.
Sitting well and holding the pencil well (Grade 1).

misconceptions.error: Hands in the first draft with crossings and does not make a clean copy.

example.question: Ni hatua gani ya mwisho ya kuandika kifungu?

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks writing ends when the words are down; the steps maandalizi, nakala ya kwanza, urekebishaji, nakala safi are new.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni hatua gani ya mwisho ya kuandika kifungu?" with "nakala ya kwanza" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show the four steps as four boxes; the child ticks each one.
misconceptions.feedback: Baada ya kurekebisha, andika nakala safi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves out words or a whole line when copying.
misconceptions.cause: The child copies letter by letter and loses his place when looking back.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Nakili: "Shule yetu ni safi."" with "Shule ni safi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Copy phrase by phrase, moving a finger along the line; read the copy back against the original.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma nakala yako na ulinganishe na ya asili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves no space between words (Mamaanapika).
misconceptions.cause: Spoken Kiswahili runs words together; the child writes the stream as he hears it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Mamaanapikachakula." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put a finger space after every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Turns b and d (or p and q) round: dada written "baba" or "bada".
misconceptions.cause: Mirror letters are common in early writing; the child has not fixed the direction.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika neno "dada"." with "bada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Teach d as "c then a tall line"; trace it in sand.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes letters floating above the line or of mixed sizes, so the line goes up and down.

example.question: Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?
example.correct_answer: juu ya mstari, herufi zikiwa na ukubwa sawa

misconceptions.cause: The child writes fast and does not look at the line.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?" with "popote kwenye ukurasa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Trace the line with a finger first; every letter sits on it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Matumizi ya Wewe na Nyinyi (Theme 1: Shuleni)
learning_experiences: kusikiliza kifungu au wimbo unaohusu nafsi ya pili (wewe na nyinyi), kutoka kwa mwalimu au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kusoma vifungu vilivyo na nafsi ya pili (wewe na nyinyi) akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutumia nafsi ya pili (wewe na nyinyi) umoja na wingi kwa kuigiza mazungumzo na wenzake katika kikundi (k.m: Wewe unasoma - Nyinyi mnasoma; Wewe ulienda shuleni - Nyinyi mlienda shuleni.),
kujaza nafasi kwa kutumia wewe na nyinyi,
kutaja zoezi la nafsi ya pili kwenye tarakilishi kwa kuburura majibu sahihi na kujaza nafasi akielekezwa na mwalimu,
kuwasiliana na mzazi au mlezi wake kwa kutumia nafsi ya pili (wewe na nyinyi).
key_inquiry_questions: Ni neno gani unaloweza kutumia kuwataja wenzako bila kutaja majina yao?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kutoa mifano kwa kutumia wewe na nyinyi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoigiza matumizi ya wewe na nyinyi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusikiliza matumizi ya wewe na nyinyi.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoweza kutumia wewe na nyinyi ifaavyo.
sub_strands.values:
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anashirikiana na wenzake katika kuigiza matumizi ya wewe na mimi na kutekeleza majukumu yake ipasavyo.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini maoni ya wenzake na kuwapatia nafasi kushiriki katika majadiliano.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapokuwa tayari kushirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za ujifunzaji.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali kuigiza mazungumzo ya nafsi ya pili wewe na nyinyi.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya matumizi ya wewe na nyinyi aliyojifunza katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English Language Activitie na Indigenous Language Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua wewe na nyinyi katika sentensi
kutumia wewe na nyinyi ipasavyo katika sentensi
kufurahia kutumia wewe na nyinyi katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia wewe na nyinyi ipasavyo katika sentensi
skills.mastery: Uses wewe to speak to one person and nyinyi to many, with the matching subject marker (wewe u-, nyinyi m-), answers a wewe-question with mimi, and puts -ku- inside the verb for "you" as object (nitakupa), in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Mimi and sisi with their verbs (Grade 1) show the pattern of a pronoun pair.
Grade 1 already met the person in the verb through simple negation.

misconceptions.error: The pronoun and the subject marker on the verb do not agree (Wao anacheza).
misconceptions.cause: The child learns the pronoun as a word and the verb as a fixed form; he has not seen that the verb changes with the person.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Nyinyi ___ (soma) vizuri." with "unasoma" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Colour the pronoun and the verb's first syllable the same colour: yeye a-, wao wa-, mimi ni-, sisi tu-, wewe u-, nyinyi m-.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitendo hufuata nafsi: Wao wanacheza; Yeye anacheza. (mnasoma)
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the one-person pronoun for many people, or the reverse.

example.question: Mwalimu anaongea na darasa zima: "___ mnafanya kazi nzuri."

misconceptions.cause: The child has not linked the pronoun pair to one and many.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anaongea na darasa zima: "___ mnafanya kazi nzuri."" with "Wewe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Point at one child, then at a group, saying the right pronoun each time.
misconceptions.feedback: Mtu mmoja ni yeye; watu wengi ni wao. (Nyinyi)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Repeats the pronoun of the question in the answer (Wewe unaenda wapi? Wewe ninaenda sokoni.) instead of switching to mimi.
misconceptions.cause: The child copies the words he heard; changing person between speakers is new.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki anakuuliza: "Wewe unaitwa nani?" Unajibu:" with "Wewe unaitwa Baraka." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask and answer in pairs with a pointing finger: wewe points out, mimi points to the chest.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukiulizwa kwa "wewe", unajibu kwa "mimi". (Mimi ninaitwa Baraka.)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts the pronoun after the verb instead of the object marker inside it (Mama alimpa mimi for Mama alinipa).
misconceptions.cause: English says "gave me"; the child adds the separate word instead of -ni- inside the verb.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Nitampa wewe kalamu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show the verb with the object marker coloured: a-li-ni-pa; compare with the wrong form.
misconceptions.feedback: Tunasema "Mama alinipa", si "alimpa mimi". (Nitakupa kalamu.)
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua silabi kwenye maneno yenye sauti lengwa katika sentensi akiwa na wenzake,
kusikiliza silabi lengwa zikitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kutamka silabi za sauti lengwa akiwa peke yake au na wenzake,
kusikiliza maneno yenye sauti lengwa yakitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali,
kutamka maneno yenye sauti lengwa yaliyotamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kifaa cha kidijitali akiwa peke yake, au na wenzake akizingatia matamshi bora,
kusikiliza sentensi zenye sauti lengwa zikisomwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kusoma sentensi za sauti lengwa zilizosomwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora,

Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutambua na kutamka maneno yenye sauti lengwa.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapojirekodi akisoma sentensi na kutambua jinsi alivyotamka sauti lengwa.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotamka sauti lengwa ipasavyo darasani.
sub_strands.values:

skills.name: Tambua na utamke silabi za sauti /mw/, /nj/ katika maneno na sentensi
skills.mastery: Hears and says the target sounds /mw/, /nj/ in syllables and words (mwalimu, njia, mwana), splits a word into its syllables, and picks or uses a word that carries the sound, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Hearing the syllables of a target sound in Grade 1 comes first.
Reading open syllables (ma, me, mi, mo, mu) in Grade 1.

misconceptions.error: Says /w/ for /mw/, so "mwezi" becomes "wezi".

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "mwezi". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

misconceptions.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /mw/, or do not separate it from /w/; the child puts in the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "mwezi". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "wezi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza: "mwezi" ina sauti /mw/, si /w/.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Pushes a vowel into the cluster, so "mwalimu" is said "muwalimu".
misconceptions.cause: In the child's first language, or in English loan habits, two consonants rarely sit together; he breaks them with a vowel.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tamka neno "mwalimu". Ni lipi sahihi?" with "muwalimu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the cluster in one beat, then the word; clap once for the cluster syllable.
misconceptions.feedback: "mwalimu" ina silabi mwa-li-mu; hakuna irabu ya ziada.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Drops part of the target sound, so "njia" becomes "jia".

example.question: Neno "njia" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?

misconceptions.cause: The second part of the sound (the w or y glide, or the soft nasal) is quick and quiet; the child does not hear it and leaves it out.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "njia" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?" with "jia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Stretch the syllable slowly (p-y-a), then say it fast; the child copies.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "njia". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Splits "mwalimu" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
misconceptions.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "mwalimu" lina silabi zipi?" with "m-w-a-l-i-m-u" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: mwa-li-mu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /mw/, /nj/?" with "kalamu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
misconceptions.feedback: "njia" ina sauti lengwa; "kalamu" haina.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua maneno yenye sauti lengwa katika kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa akiwa peke yake, au na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kuhusu haki za mtoto (k.v. upendo, mavazi, makao, chakula) kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa sauti inayosikika akiwa peke yake, au na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno 33 kwa dakika) na kwa kuzingatia viakifishi,
kusoma kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara zifaazo akiwa peke yake, au na wenzake,
kusoma hadithi kutoka kwenye kitabu, kifaa cha kidijtali akiwa peke yake, au na wenzake, akizingatia sauti inayosikika, matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo na ishara zinazofaa,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu chepesi chenye sauti lengwa akizingatia matamshi bora, sauti inayosikika, kasi na ishara zifaazo.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni mambo gani unayozingatia ili kusoma kwa ufasaha?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kuchangia kikamilifu kutambua sauti na kusoma maneno na sentensi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kusoma maneno na sentensi zenye sauti lengwa.
Uwazaji kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi na kutoa mchango wao.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na kushirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapochukua majukumu mbalimbali katika kazi ya kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Haki za watoto: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu chepesi kuhusu haki za watoto akizingatia matamshi bora, kasi ifaayo, sauti inayosikika na ishara zifaazo.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kinachuzungumzia suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma anayojifunza katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities.

kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa sauti inayosikika
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara zifaazo

skills.name: Soma kifungu chepesi chenye sauti /mw/, /nj/ kwa matamshi bora, sauti inayosikika, kasi ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Finds the target sounds /mw/, /nj/ in a short story, reads it aloud with every sound clear, loud enough for the class, at about 33 words a minute, pausing at the koma and kikomo and raising the voice for a question; in the app picks the better reading of a line, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Saying the syllables of mw and nj comes before reading them in a passage.
Reading short sentences with target sounds in Grade 1.

misconceptions.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "mwanafunzi" as "muwanafunzi".
misconceptions.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "mwanafunzi" linasomwa vipi?" with "muwanafunzi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma "mwanafunzi" kama lilivyoandikwa.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Kila mtoto ana haki ya chakula."?
example.wrong_answer: Kila ... mtoto ... ana ... haki ... ya ... chakula.
example.correct_answer: Kila mtoto ana haki ya chakula.

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Kila mtoto ana haki ya chakula."?" with "Kila ... mtoto ... ana ... haki ... ya ... chakula." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

misconceptions.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 33 kwa dakika

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, una nguo safi?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, una nguo safi?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Hati Nadhifu Herufi Kubwa (Theme 2: Haki zangu)
learning_experiences: kutambua mpangilio ufaao wa herufi kubwa katika matini (k.v. kadi maneno, mti maneno, picha, chati, kitabu, kifaa cha kidijitali, n.k.) akiwa peke yake, au na wenzake,
kunakili maneno na sentensi kuhusu mada lengwa (k.v upendo, kupata elimu, chakula, mavazi, makazi) kwa kuzingatia mpangilio ufaao wa herufi kubwa,
kutunga na kuandika sentensi fupi akizingatia mpangilio ufaao wa herufi kubwa,
kushirikiana na wenzake kutathmini sentensi walizotunga,

key_inquiry_questions: Je herufi kubwa huwa na sifa gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuwaonyesha wenzake herufi kubwa ilipotumiwa katika maneno na sentensi. Pia anaposhiriki kutambua na kuandika herufi kubwa katika kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapoandika herufi kubwa katika maneno na sentensi akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomwandikia mlezi au mzazi wake maneno kwa kutumia herufi kubwa ipasavyo.

skills.name: Andika kwa hati nadhifu ukitumia herufi kubwa ifaavyo
skills.mastery: Writes a passage of about 15 words in neat handwriting: letters well formed and on the line, capitals only at the start of a sentence or name, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Neat sentences (Theme 1) come first.
Forming the capital letters in Grade 1.

misconceptions.error: Starts a sentence or a name with a small letter.

example.question: Andika kwa usahihi: mwalimu akinyi anafundisha darasa la pili.
example.wrong_answer: mwalimu akinyi anafundisha darasa la pili.
example.correct_answer: Mwalimu Akinyi anafundisha darasa la pili.

misconceptions.cause: The child copies words, not sentences; the rule that a sentence and a name begin with a capital is not yet used.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika kwa usahihi: mwalimu akinyi anafundisha darasa la pili." with "mwalimu akinyi anafundisha darasa la pili." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Circle the first letter of each sentence and each name in a passage in red.
misconceptions.feedback: Sentensi na jina la mtu au mahali huanza kwa herufi kubwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts capital letters in the middle of words (JuMa, Kitabu KiKubwa).
misconceptions.cause: Some capitals (K, M, S) are easier to form than the small letter, so the child uses them anywhere.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "JuMa ANakula" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort letter cards: capital only at the start; the rest small.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi kubwa iko mwanzoni tu; nyingine ni ndogo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves no space between words (Mamaanapika).
misconceptions.cause: Spoken Kiswahili runs words together; the child writes the stream as he hears it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Mamaanapikachakula." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put a finger space after every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Turns b and d (or p and q) round: dada written "baba" or "bada".
misconceptions.cause: Mirror letters are common in early writing; the child has not fixed the direction.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika neno "dada"." with "bada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Teach d as "c then a tall line"; trace it in sand.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes letters floating above the line or of mixed sizes, so the line goes up and down.

example.question: Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?
example.correct_answer: juu ya mstari, herufi zikiwa na ukubwa sawa

misconceptions.cause: The child writes fast and does not look at the line.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?" with "popote kwenye ukurasa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Trace the line with a finger first; every letter sits on it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Umoja na Wingi wa Vifungu (Theme 2: Haki zangu)

kuandika vifungu vya maneno mawili katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake. (k.v chakula changu-vyakula vyetu)
kujaza nafasi kwa kukamilisha vifungu vya maneno katika umoja na wingi akishirikiana na wenzake,
kushiriki katika mchezo wa kupanga kadi za vifungu vya maneno akiambatanisha umoja na wingi,

Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika vifungu vya maneno katika umoja na wingi.

Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotumia na kutunza vifaa vya kidijitali ipasavyo.

kuandika vifungu vya maneno mawili katika umoja na wingi
kuchangamkia kutumia vifungu vya maneno katika umoja na wingi

skills.name: Badilisha vifungu vya maneno mawili kutoka umoja hadi wingi
skills.mastery: Turns a two-word group from singular to plural and back (chakula changu - vyakula vyetu, kitanda changu - vitanda vyetu), changing the noun by its ngeli and the word that goes with it, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Singular and plural of single nouns (Grade 1) come before two-word groups.
-angu and -etu (Grade 1) are the second word of these groups.

misconceptions.error: Makes the plural with the prefix of another noun class (kitabu -> watabu).
misconceptions.cause: The child knows that wa- makes people plural and uses it for everything; the ngeli of the noun is not yet known.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "kitanda changu" ni?" with "watanda wetu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort noun cards into ngeli families (m-wa, ki-vi, li-ma, n-n) and say each plural aloud.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila ngeli ina wingi wake: kitabu - vitabu, mtoto - watoto. (vitanda vyetu)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves the possessive singular with a plural noun (vitabu changu).
misconceptions.cause: The child changes the noun and forgets the possessive.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "kiatu changu" ni?" with "viatu changu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Change one object to many in front of the child; both words change.
misconceptions.feedback: Vitabu vyangu: vyote viwili hubadilika. (viatu vyetu)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Shows the plural only with a number word and leaves the noun singular (kitabu mbili).
misconceptions.cause: English and some first languages keep the noun and add a number; Kiswahili changes the noun and the number agrees.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Wingi wa "kikombe kimoja" ni?" with "kikombe viwili" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Line up two books: the child says vitabu viwili; then three: vitabu vitatu.
misconceptions.feedback: Nomino hubadilika pia: vitabu viwili. (vikombe viwili)
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Takes the plural form for the singular (miti for one tree, vitabu for one book).

example.question: Ni kifungu kipi kiko katika umoja?

misconceptions.cause: The child heard the plural more often (a tree is usually among trees) and learnt it as the name.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kifungu kipi kiko katika umoja?" with "vyakula vyetu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Hold one object, then many; the child names each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kimoja ni kitabu; vingi ni vitabu. (chakula changu)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the wrong noun-class form of the possessive (kitabu yangu for kitabu changu).
misconceptions.cause: Town Kiswahili uses yangu, yako, yake for every noun; the child has not seen the ngeli agreement.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: chakula ___ (-angu)" with "yangu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair nouns and possessives by colour: kitabu changu, kiti chake, mtoto wangu.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitabu changu; kiti chake: kimilikishi hufuata ngeli. (changu)
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Maneno ya Heshima na Adabu (Theme 3: Lishe bora)
content_topics: Hodi, karibu, tafadhali, ninaomba, nisamehe na nashukuru.
learning_experiences: kutambua maneno ya heshima na adabu yanayotumiwa katika jamii,
kujadili ni lini maneno husika yanatumiwa katika mawasiliano akiwa na wenzake,
kutazama michoro mbalimbali na kujadili neno linalofaa kutumiwa katika miktadha husika,
kutazama video kuhusu matumizi ya maneno ya heshima na adabu,
kuambatanisha matumizi ya maneno ya heshima na adabu katika mazungumzo na hisia katika maigizo,
kuwasiliana na mzazi au mlezi kwa kutumia maneno ya adabu na heshima ifaavyo.
key_inquiry_questions: Maneno ya adabu huwa na sifa gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki na kuchangia kikamilifu katika majadiliano kuhusu maneno ya heshima na adabu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kutazama maigizo kuhusu vitendo vya heshima na adabu.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapoigiza kuhusu matumizi ya maneno ya heshima na adabu.
Uraia: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kujadili matumizi ya maneno ya heshima na adabu.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapotumia maneno ya heshima na adabu.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia kujifunzia.
sub_strands.pcis:
Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anapowapa wenzake nafasi ya kutoa hoja zao katika kikundi na pia anapotumia maneno ya heshima na adabu katika mawasiliano.
Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotazama video kuhusu matumizi ya maneno ya heshima na adabu azingatie hatua za kiusalama.
sub_strands.links:
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha matumizi ya maneno ya heshima na adabu katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English Language Activitie na Indigenous Language Activities.
Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala hili la lishe bora na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Environmental Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua maneno ya heshima na adabu yanayotumiwa katika jamii
kutumia ipasavyo maneno ya heshima na adabu katika mawasiliano akiambatanisha na hisia zifaazo
kuthamini matumizi ya maneno ya heshima na adabu katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tumia maneno ya heshima na adabu: tafadhali, asante, samahani, pole, karibu
skills.mastery: Picks and uses the polite word that fits the situation (tafadhali or naomba to ask, asante to thank, karibu to answer asante, samahani to apologise, pole to sympathise) and addresses an adult with a title, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: The words of courtesy of Grade 1 come first.
Greeting properly comes before a polite request.

misconceptions.error: Says samahani when someone else is hurt by accident, where pole (sympathy) is meant.

example.question: Rafiki ameanguka mwenyewe uwanjani. Unamwambia nini?

misconceptions.cause: English "sorry" covers both apology and sympathy; Kiswahili separates them: samahani when I did wrong, pole when you suffer.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki ameanguka mwenyewe uwanjani. Unamwambia nini?" with "Samahani" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Two pictures: I stepped on your foot (samahani); you fell by yourself (pole). The child names each.
misconceptions.feedback: Pole ni ya kumhurumia aliyeumia; samahani ni ya kuomba msamaha ukikosea.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers "Asante" with "Asante" instead of "Karibu" (or "Si neno").

example.question: Ulimpa rafiki kalamu, akasema "Asante." Unajibu nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child echoes the polite word he has just heard.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ulimpa rafiki kalamu, akasema "Asante." Unajibu nini?" with "Asante" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise the pair with two children: one gives, one thanks, the giver answers Karibu.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukishukuriwa, unajibu "Karibu."
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Asks with a bare command (Nipe maji!) without tafadhali or naomba.

example.question: Unataka maji kutoka kwa mama. Unasemaje?

misconceptions.cause: At home and in play the child hears short commands and copies them to adults.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unataka maji kutoka kwa mama. Unasemaje?" with "Nipe maji!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say both versions; the child says which one makes mama want to help.
misconceptions.feedback: Ombi la adabu lina "tafadhali" au "naomba."
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Calls an adult by the bare first name without a title (Mwalimu, Mama, Baba, Bi., Bw.).

example.question: Unamwita mwalimu wako, Bi. Akinyi. Unasemaje?

misconceptions.cause: Children call each other by name and carry the habit to adults.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unamwita mwalimu wako, Bi. Akinyi. Unasemaje?" with "Akinyi, njoo!" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Make title cards (Mwalimu, Mama, Babu, Daktari); the child puts one before each name.
misconceptions.feedback: Mtu mzima huitwa kwa heshima: Mwalimu, Mama, Babu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers "Pole" with "Pole" instead of "Asante".
misconceptions.cause: The child echoes the word, as with greetings.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Rafiki anakuambia "Pole kwa kuumia." Unajibu?" with "Pole" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act it: one child is hurt, the other says pole, the hurt one says asante.
misconceptions.feedback: Ukiambiwa "pole" unashukuru: "Asante."
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa ufahamu Kusoma kifungu (Theme 3: Lishe bora)
learning_experiences: kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno 35 -38 na kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa (afya, nguvu, protini, wanga, vitamini) akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutabiri kitakachotokea katika hadithi akizingatia picha kwenye kifungu akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutabiri ujumbe wa kifungu cha hadithi kwa kutazama picha kwenye kitabu, vifaa vya kidijitali au chati akishirikiana na wenzake,
kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha hadithi akiwa na wenzake,
kuthibitisha utabiri wake kuhusu hadithi baada ya kuisoma,
kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa ipasavyo katika mawasiliano,
kueleza mafunzo yanayotokana na kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu akiwa na wenzake,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu chepesi cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa.
key_inquiry_questions: Je unazingatia nini ilikupata ujumbe katika ufahamu?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi na kuchangia kikamilifu katika kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kijiditali kutazama picha na kusoma kifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi wake na kumweleza ujumbe katika kifungu chepesi.
Uwazaji kwa kina na utatuzi wa matatizo: mwanafunzi anapotabiri na kufikia uamuzi wa mafunzo anayopata kwenye kifungu cha ufahamu.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi kujadili ujumbe na kutabiri kitakachotokea kwenye hadithi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali darasani.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza kifaa cha kidijitali anachotumia kujifunzia.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya afya ya kujikinga: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi na kutumia msamiati kuhusu lishe bora, ujuzi wake wa kujikinga dhidi ya maradhi mbalimbali unapanuka.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anaposoma matini kuhusu suala lengwa kuhusu lishe bora.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma kwa ufahamu na katika somo hili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English Language Activitie na Indigenous Language Activities. Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha suala hili la lishe bora na masuala yanayofunzwa katika somo la Environmental Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua msamiati kuhusu suala lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha hadithi
kutabiri yatakayotokea katika kifungu chepesi cha hadithi kwa kuzingatia picha
kueleza ujumbe wa kifungu chepesi cha hadithi
kueleza mafunzo yanayotokana na kifungu chepesi cha hadithi
kuchangamkia kusoma vifungu vya ufahamu ili kuimarisha stadi ya kusoma

skills.name: Soma kifungu chepesi: msamiati, ujumbe, kutabiri na mafunzo
skills.mastery: Reads a short passage on lishe bora, gives the meaning of a theme word from the sentence around it, says the message, predicts what happens next from the clues in the picture and says the lesson, answering from the passage and not from his own life, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: The comprehension questions of Theme 1 come back here.
Answering about a short read passage in Grade 1.

misconceptions.error: Gives "afya" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Kila asubuhi, Baraka hula uji na ndizi. Mchana hula wali, maharagwe na mboga. Mama husema chakula bora hutupa nguvu na afya." Neno "afya" lina maana gani?
example.correct_answer: hali ya mwili kuwa mzima bila ugonjwa

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Soma: "Kila asubuhi, Baraka hula uji na ndizi. Mchana hula wali, maharagwe na mboga. Mama husema chakula bora hutupa nguvu na afya." Neno "afya" lina maana gani?" with "nyanya" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
misconceptions.feedback: Katika kifungu, "afya" ni hali ya mwili kuwa mzima bila ugonjwa.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tule chakula bora ili tuwe na nguvu na afya.

misconceptions.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Baraka hula uji asubuhi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
misconceptions.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tule chakula bora ili tuwe na nguvu na afya.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for, without looking at the picture.

example.question: Picha inaonyesha Baraka akikataa mboga. Mama atafanya nini?

misconceptions.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha Baraka akikataa mboga. Mama atafanya nini?" with "Atampa pipi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the clue words and point at the picture; the guess must fit them.
misconceptions.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za picha na za kifungu: Atamweleza umuhimu wa kula mboga.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kula vyakula vya aina mbalimbali.

misconceptions.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Baraka hula wali mchana." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
misconceptions.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kula vyakula vya aina mbalimbali.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.
misconceptions.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Baraka hula nini asubuhi?" with "Mimi hunywa chai." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu liko kwenye kifungu: uji na ndizi
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Mpangilio wa Herufi Ndogo (Theme 3: Lishe bora)
learning_experiences: kutambua mpangilio ufaao wa herufi ndogo katika maandishi kwenye kadi maneno, chati, daftari au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kuwaonyesha wenzake mpangilio ufaao wa herufi ndogo kwenye kadi maneno, kitabu, chati au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kunakili kifungu akizingatia mpangilio ufaao wa herufi ndogo akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika kifungu akizingatia mpangilio ufaao wa herufi ndogo,
kutunga kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia mpangilio unaofaa.
key_inquiry_questions: Kwa nini ni vizuri kuandika herufi ndogo ipasavyo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutambua na kuandika akizingatia mpangilio ufaao wa herufi ndogo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika kifungu cha maneno akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika akizingatia mpangilio ufaao wa herufu ndogo.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kazi za kikundi na kuheshimu maoni yao.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuthamini maoni ya wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli za kuandika.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kazi za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Mahusiano ya kijamii: mwanafunzi anapowathamini wenzake kutoka jamii mbalimbali wanaposhirikiana kunakili kifungu wakizingatia mpangilio ufaao wa herufi ndogo.

outcomes.text: kutambua mpangilio ufaao wa herufi ndogo katika maandishi
kuandika kifungu akizingatia mpangilio ufaao wa herufi ndogo
kuchangamkia kuandika vifungu kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia mpangilio ufaao wa herufi ndogo ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Andika kwa hati nadhifu ukitumia herufi ndogo ifaavyo
skills.mastery: Writes a passage of about 20 words in neat handwriting: letters well formed and on the line, small letters of the right height, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Neat sentences (Theme 1) come first.
Forming the small letters in Grade 1.

misconceptions.error: Writes the tall small letters (b, d, h, k, l) short, so h looks like n.

example.question: Andika neno "habari". Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?

misconceptions.cause: The child does not use the lines of the book: tall letters must reach the top line.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika neno "habari". Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "nabari" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Write on three-line paper; the child colours the part of h that goes up.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi h, k, l, b, d hupanda juu ya mstari wa kati.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes some small letters as big as capitals (kiti written kiTi or KITI).

example.question: Ni neno lipi limeandikwa kwa herufi ndogo vizuri?

misconceptions.cause: Capitals were learnt first in pre-primary and feel safer to write.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi limeandikwa kwa herufi ndogo vizuri?" with "KITI" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Compare k/K, s/S, t/T on cards; the child picks the small one for the middle of a word.
misconceptions.feedback: Ndani ya neno tumia herufi ndogo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Leaves no space between words (Mamaanapika).
misconceptions.cause: Spoken Kiswahili runs words together; the child writes the stream as he hears it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Mamaanapikachakula." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put a finger space after every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Acha nafasi ya kidole kati ya neno na neno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Turns b and d (or p and q) round: dada written "baba" or "bada".
misconceptions.cause: Mirror letters are common in early writing; the child has not fixed the direction.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika neno "dada"." with "bada" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Teach d as "c then a tall line"; trace it in sand.
misconceptions.feedback: Herufi d huanza kama c, kisha mstari mrefu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes letters floating above the line or of mixed sizes, so the line goes up and down.

example.question: Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?
example.correct_answer: juu ya mstari, herufi zikiwa na ukubwa sawa

misconceptions.cause: The child writes fast and does not look at the line.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Maandishi nadhifu yanakaa wapi?" with "popote kwenye ukurasa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Trace the line with a finger first; every letter sits on it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila herufi ikae juu ya mstari.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Matumizi ya Huyo na Hao (Theme 3: Lishe bora)
learning_experiences: kutambua matumizi ya huyo na hao kwa kutumia nyenzo kama vile kadi maneno, mti maneno, kapu maneno au chati,
kusilikiliza kifungu au wimbo kuhusu matumizi ya huyo na hao katika kifaa cha kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutambua huyo na hao katika kifungu au wimbo aliosikiliza kwa kuongozwa na mwalimu,
kusoma sentensi zenye kudhihirisha matumizi ya huyo na hao kama vile: mtoto huyo anakula chakula. Watoto hao wanakula chakula.
kuigiza vitendo vya kuwaashiria watu mbalimbali kwa kutumia huyo na hao,
kumtungia mwenzake katika kikundi sentensi kwa kutumia huyu na hao,
kuandika sentensi zinazodhihirisha matumizi ya huyo na hao kama vile: mtoto huyo anasoma watoto hao wanasoma
kujaza nafasi kwa kutumia huyo na hao akielekezwa na mwalimu.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni maneno gani yatatumiwa kuonyesha mwenzako akiwa mbali kidogo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kumtungia mwenzake sentensi akitumia huyo na hao.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoigiza matumizi ya huyo na hao akishirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia huyo na hao kwa lugha fasaha.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kurejelea watu wa familia yake kwa kutumia huyo na hao ipasavyo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu mchango wa wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi wanapotungiana sentensi kwa kutumia huyo na hao.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kumshirikisha mzazi au mlezi wake katika kurejelea watu wa familia yake kwa kutumia maneno huyu na hao.

outcomes.text: kutambua matumizi ya huyo na hao katika kifungu
kutumia huyo na hao katika sentensi kwa usahihi
kuchangamkia matumizi ya huyo na hao katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tumia huyo na hao ipasavyo katika sentensi
skills.mastery: Uses huyo for one person near the listener and hao for many, tells them from huyu/hawa (near the speaker), and uses hicho/hivyo, not huyo, for ki-vi things, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Huyu and hawa (Grade 1) are the first pointing words.
Hiki and hivi (Grade 1) show that things take other pointing words.

misconceptions.error: Uses the people word (huyu, yule) for a thing (kiti huyu).

example.question: Jaza: Kikombe ___ (kilicho karibu nawe) ni chako.

misconceptions.cause: Huyu was the first pointing word learnt; the child uses it for anything.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Kikombe ___ (kilicho karibu nawe) ni chako." with "huyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Point at a child (huyu) and at a chair (hiki); then sort pictures by the pointing word they take.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitu cha ngeli ya ki-vi huonyeshwa kwa hiki; mtu huonyeshwa kwa huyu. (hicho)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the one-thing pointing word with a plural noun (watoto huyu).

example.question: Jaza: Wapishi ___ (walio karibu nawe) ni hodari.

misconceptions.cause: The child changes the noun but not the pointing word.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Wapishi ___ (walio karibu nawe) ni hodari." with "huyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair the forms on cards: huyu-hawa, yule-wale, hiki-hivi, hili-haya.
misconceptions.feedback: Watoto ni wengi: watoto hawa. (hao)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes near and far pointing words (huyu for someone far away; yule for someone close).

example.question: Mtoto amesimama karibu nami. Ninasema: Mtoto ___ ni dada yangu.

misconceptions.cause: The child has not linked the forms to distance from the speaker.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mtoto amesimama karibu nami. Ninasema: Mtoto ___ ni dada yangu." with "huyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Stand near one child and far from another; point and say huyu and yule; then swap places.
misconceptions.feedback: Huyu ni karibu nami; yule ni mbali. (huyu)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses hii for every noun (kitabu hii, mtoto hii), as in town Kiswahili.

example.question: Jaza: Mama ___ (aliye karibu nawe) anauza matunda.

misconceptions.cause: Hii is the pointing word heard most in town speech, where the noun class is dropped.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Mama ___ (aliye karibu nawe) anauza matunda." with "hii" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read pairs aloud: kitabu hiki, mtoto huyu, nyumba hii; the child hears the match.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitabu hiki; mtoto huyu; nyumba hii. (huyo)
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua silabi za sauti lengwa (/ch/ na /dh/) katika maneno kwenye kadi maneno, chati, mti maneno, sentensi, au kifaa cha kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake,
kushirikiana na kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali (k.v. kupitia Programu ya Papaya) kusikiliza matamshi bora ya silabi za sauti lengwa,
kusikiliza maneno yenye silabi za sauti lengwa yakisomwa na wenzake darasani kisha kutambua sauti hizo katika maneno hayo,

kusoma kifungu kifupi chenye maneno ya silabi za sauti lengwa kutoka kwa kitabu au kifaa cha kidijitali akiwa na wenzake,
kuimba wimbo akizingatia sauti lengwa kuhusu kuweka mazingira ya barabara safi. .
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni maneno gani unayojua yenye sauti /ch/ na /dh/?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutambua na kutamka maneno yenye sauti lengwa.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali akisoma kifungu na kutamka sauti lengwa ipasavyo.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutamka sauti lengwa ipasavyo.

Heshima: mwanafunzi anapothamini matamshi ya wenzake katika shughuli za vikundi.
sub_strands.pcis: Usalama mtandaoni: mwanafunzi anapotumia kifaa cha kidijitali kusoma kifungu kifupi chenye maneno ya sauti lengwa azingatie hatua za kiusalama.

skills.name: Tambua na utamke silabi za sauti /ch/, /dh/ katika maneno na sentensi
skills.mastery: Hears and says the target sounds /ch/, /dh/ in syllables and words (chombo, dhoruba, chai), splits a word into its syllables, and picks or uses a word that carries the sound, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Splitting words into syllables (Theme 2) comes before the two-letter sounds ch and dh.
Hearing target syllables in Grade 1.

misconceptions.error: Says /z/ for /dh/, so "dhoruba" becomes "zoruba".

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "dhoruba". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

misconceptions.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /dh/, or do not separate it from /z/; the child puts in the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "dhoruba". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "zoruba" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza: "dhoruba" ina sauti /dh/, si /z/.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /sh/ for /ch/, so "chombo" becomes "shombo".
misconceptions.cause: /ch/ and /sh/ are close; a first language with only one of them puts that one in both places.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "shombo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Contrast the two with a mirror and a hand before the mouth; the child says which he hears.
misconceptions.feedback: "chombo" ina sauti /ch/.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Drops part of the target sound, so "dhahabu" becomes "dahabu".

example.question: Neno "dhahabu" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?

misconceptions.cause: The second part of the sound (the w or y glide, or the soft nasal) is quick and quiet; the child does not hear it and leaves it out.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "dhahabu" limeandikwa au kutamkwa vipi kwa usahihi?" with "dahabu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Stretch the syllable slowly (p-y-a), then say it fast; the child copies.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza tena: "dhahabu". Usiache sehemu ya sauti.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Splits "chombo" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
misconceptions.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "chombo" lina silabi zipi?" with "c-h-o-m-b-o" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: cho-mbo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /ch/, /dh/?" with "basi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
misconceptions.feedback: "dhoruba" ina sauti lengwa; "basi" haina.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua sauti /ch/na /dh/ katika kadi maneno, mti maneno au kifaa cha kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno au hadithi yenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara zifaazo, matamshi bora akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno au hadithi yenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara zifaazo, sauti inayosikika akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno au hadithi yenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara zifaazo, kasi ifaayo (maneno 36 kwa dakika na kwa kuzingatia viakifishi) akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusoma hadithi kutoka kwenye kitabu, kifaa cha kidijtali, n.k akishirikiana na wenzake na kuzingatia sauti inayosikika, matamshi bora, kasi na ishara zifaazo,
kusoma hadithi kutoka kwenye kitabu, kifaa cha kidijtali, n.k akishirikiana na wenzake akizingatia sauti inayosikika, matamshi bora, kasi na ishara zifaazo.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ni mambo gani unazingatia kusoma kwa ufasaha?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia kikamilifu katika shughuli za kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kujifunzia matamshi ya sauti lengwa.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoendelea kusoma vifungu mbalimbali maishani.

Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapowajibikia majukumu aliyopewa katika kikundi.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapowaheshimu wenzake wanaposoma kifungu chepesi kwa kutumia ishara zifaazo.
sub_strands.pcis: Mshikamano wa kijamii: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutoka sehemu mbalimbali kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kutoka kwenye kitabu au kifaa cha kidijaitali.

kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora

kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara zifaazo

skills.name: Soma kifungu chepesi chenye sauti /ch/, /dh/ kwa matamshi bora, sauti inayosikika, kasi ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Finds the target sounds /ch/, /dh/ in a short story, reads it aloud with every sound clear, loud enough for the class, at about 36 words a minute, pausing at the koma and kikomo and raising the voice for a question; in the app picks the better reading of a line, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Saying ch and dh comes before reading them aloud.
Reading aloud at a fitting pace and volume, from Theme 2.

misconceptions.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "dhahabu" as "zahabu".
misconceptions.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "dhahabu" linasomwa vipi?" with "zahabu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma "dhahabu" kama lilivyoandikwa.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Basi linabeba abiria wengi."?

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Basi linabeba abiria wengi."?" with "Basi ... linabeba ... abiria ... wengi." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

misconceptions.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 36 kwa dakika

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, dereva amefunga mkanda?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, dereva amefunga mkanda?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
