outcomes.text: kutambua maneno na sentensi zenye sauti lengwa
kutamka maneno na sentensi za sauti lengwa kwa ufasaha
kufurahia matamshi bora katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tambua na utamke silabi za sauti /gh/, /ng'/ katika maneno na sentensi
skills.mastery: Hears and says the target sounds /gh/, /ng'/ in syllables and words (ghafla, ng'ombe, ghala), splits a word into its syllables, and picks or uses a word that carries the sound, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Syllables of target sounds (Theme 2) come first.
Hearing target syllables in Grade 1.

misconceptions.error: Says /g/ for /gh/, so "ghafla" becomes "gafla".

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "ghafla". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

misconceptions.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /gh/, or do not separate it from /g/; the child puts in the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "ghafla". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "gafla" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza: "ghafla" ina sauti /gh/, si /g/.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /ng/ for /ng'/, so "ng'ombe" becomes "ngombe".
misconceptions.cause: /ng'/ and /ng/ are close; a first language with only one of them puts that one in both places.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "ngombe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Contrast the two with a mirror and a hand before the mouth; the child says which he hears.
misconceptions.feedback: "ng'ombe" ina sauti /ng'/.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Splits "ghafla" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
misconceptions.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "ghafla" lina silabi zipi?" with "g-h-a-f-l-a" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: gha-fla.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /gh/, /ng'/?" with "taa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
misconceptions.feedback: "ng'ombe" ina sauti lengwa; "taa" haina.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua sauti katika kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora akishirikiana na wenzake kuhusu suala lengwa,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa sauti inayosikika akishirikiana na wenzake kuhusu suala lengwa,
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno 42 kwa dakika na kwa kuizingatia viakifishi) akishirikiana na wenzake,

kusoma kifungu cha hadithi kutoka kwenye kitabu au kifaa cha kidijtali, akishirikiana na wenzake kuhusu usalama wangu na jinsi ya kudumisha usalama barabarani, akizingatia sauti inayosikika, matamshi bora, kasi na ishara zifaazo.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unajua kusoma maneno gani yenye sauti /sh/ na /th/?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuchangia kikamilifu katika shughuli za kikundi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali katika ujifunzaji.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoendelea kusoma sentensi na vifungu mbalimbali vyenye sauti lengwa.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake kwenye kikundi.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapotunza vifaa vya kidijitali anavyotumia kujifunzia.
sub_strands.pcis:
Utunzi na usalama wa watoto: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kinachohusu suala lengwa, anakuza ujuzi wake kuhusu masuala ya usalama.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anaposoma vifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kusoma vifungu anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua sauti lengwa katika kifungu chepesi cha hadithi
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa sauti inayosikika
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo
kusoma kifungu chepesi cha hadithi chenye sauti lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara zifaazo
kuchangamkia kusoma kwa ufasaha ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Soma kifungu chepesi chenye sauti /gh/, /ng'/ kwa matamshi bora, sauti inayosikika, kasi ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Finds the target sounds /gh/, /ng'/ in a short story, reads it aloud with every sound clear, loud enough for the class, at about 42 words a minute, pausing at the koma and kikomo and raising the voice for a question; in the app picks the better reading of a line, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Saying gh and ng' comes before reading them aloud.
Reading short sentences aloud in Grade 1.

misconceptions.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "ng'ambo" as "ngambo".
misconceptions.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "ng'ambo" linasomwa vipi?" with "ngambo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma "ng'ambo" kama lilivyoandikwa.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Tunavuka barabara kwa uangalifu."?

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Tunavuka barabara kwa uangalifu."?" with "Tunavuka ... barabara ... kwa ... uangalifu." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

misconceptions.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 42 kwa dakika

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, umeangalia kulia na kushoto?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, umeangalia kulia na kushoto?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua tahajia sahihi za maneno katika sentensi kwenye kitabu au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kushirikiana na wenzake kujadili kuhusu tahajia sahihi ya maneno kwenye kifungu kitabuni au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kuandika sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia tahajia sahihi za maneno,
kurekebisha sentensi akizingatia tahajia sahihi,
kujaza nafasi kwenye kifungu akizingatia tahajia sahihi kuhusu suala lengwa,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi sentensi alizotunga akizingatia tahajia sahihi ili ampe maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, kwa nini ni vizuri kuandika maneno kwa kuzingatia tahajia ifaayo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi na kuchangia kikamilifu katika kutambua na kuandika akizingatia tahajia sahihi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kuandika sentensi zinazozingatia tahajia akitumia kifaa cha kidijitali.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutumia tahajia sahihi katika sentensi.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuheshimu maoni yao.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuwathamini wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli za kuandika.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kazi za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Usalama wa watoto barabarani: mwanafunzi anapotambua tahajia sahihi za maneno katika sentensi kwenye kitabu au kifaa cha kidijitali akizingatia mada lengwa.
Haki za watoto: mwanafunzi anapoandika sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha dhana ya tahajia anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa dhana hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua tahajia sahihi za maneno katika sentensi
kuandika sentensi akizingatia tahajia sahihi za maneno
kufurahia kutumia tahajia sahihi katika maandishi

skills.name: Andika insha fupi kwa tahajia sahihi za maneno
skills.mastery: Writes the words of his own writing (about 20 words) with the right letters: the Kiswahili sound and not the home sound, the nasal kept (nd, mb, ng), long vowels doubled and ng' with its apostrophe, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Spelling from dictation comes before spelling in his own sentences.
Spelling simple words in Grade 1.

misconceptions.error: Spells the word with the sound of his first language: "barabara" written "balabala".
misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he says the word; if his first language merges the two sounds, the letter is a guess.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "balabala" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a list of the class's hard pairs (l/r, s/sh, z/dh, s/th); say each word slowly before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Andika "barabara" kama linavyotamkwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Drops the nasal: "mbele" written "bele".
misconceptions.cause: The n or m before a consonant is soft and quick; the child does not hear it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "bele" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Hum the nasal before the word (mmm-bwa, nnn-dege).
misconceptions.feedback: "mbele" lina sauti ya pua mwanzoni.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes a long vowel short, so the word changes: "taa" written "ta".

example.question: Andika neno lenye maana ya "kifaa cha kutoa mwanga".

misconceptions.cause: The child hears the length but does not know it is shown by two letters.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika neno lenye maana ya "kifaa cha kutoa mwanga"." with "ta" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the two vowels as two beats; compare a word with one and two vowels.
misconceptions.feedback: "taa" lina irabu mbili zinazofuatana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes ng' without the apostrophe (ngombe for ng'ombe), or puts it where it does not belong (ng'oma for ngoma).

example.question: Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?

misconceptions.cause: Ng' and ng are two sounds; the apostrophe looks like dirt on the page to the child.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?" with "ngombe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say ng'ombe and ngoma: the first has no g sound; mark it with the apostrophe.
misconceptions.feedback: Ng'ombe huandikwa na kibainishi: ng'.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Joins two words into one, or splits one word into two (kwasababu; mwana funzi).
misconceptions.cause: In speech the words run together; the child has not seen each written apart.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Nilichelewa kwasababu ya mvua." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Count the words aloud with a finger for each before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: "Kwa sababu" ni maneno mawili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Matumizi ya huu na hii (Theme 8: Usalama wangu)
learning_experiences: kutambua maneno huu na hii kwa kutumia nyenzo kama vile kadi maneno, mti maneno, chati au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kusoma vifungu vinavyojumuisha huu na hii,
kuonyesha vitu mbalimbali kuhusu suala lengwa kama vile miti na kuvitungia sentensi katika kikundi (k.m Mti huu – miti hii,)
kukamilisha vifungu vyenye nafasi kwa kutumia huu na hii akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutunga sentensi akitumia huu na hii na zinazolenga suala lengwa, kuandika vifungu akitumia huu na hii kutokana na picha.
key_inquiry_questions: Ni vitu gani unavyoweza kurejelea kwa kutumia maneno huu na hii?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutambua maneno huu na hii na kutunga sentensi akiyatumia.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: anapomshirikisha mzazi au mlezi wake kurejelea vitu vinavyopatikana nyumbani kwa kutumia maneno huu na hii ipasavyo.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kiteknolojia kujifunzia.
sub_strands.values: Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutunga sentensi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Magonjwa ya kuambukizwa na yasiyoambukizwa: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu chepesi kuhusu usalama wangu akitumia huu na hii kutokana na picha ipasavyo.
Haki za watoto: mwanafunzi anapoandika sentensi kuhusu suala lengwa
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya sarufi kuhusu vionyeshi anavyojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities.
sub_strands.design_notes: Second read left this for a person to confirm: outcome letters read as aab.

outcomes.text: kutambua huu na hii katika vifungu
kutumia huu na hii kutajia vitu katika mazingira yake
kuchangamkia matumizi ya huu na hii katika mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia huu na hii kutaja vitu vilivyo karibu
skills.mastery: Uses huu with a near m-mi noun in the singular and hii in the plural (mti huu - miti hii, mlango huu - milango hii), and ule for one far away, not huyu or hii for everything, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Huyo and hao (Theme 3) are the pointing words before huu and hii.
Hiki and hivi (Grade 1).

misconceptions.error: Uses the people word (huyu, yule) for a thing (kiti huyu).
misconceptions.cause: Huyu was the first pointing word learnt; the child uses it for anything.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Mlango ___ ni mpana." with "huyu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Point at a child (huyu) and at a chair (hiki); then sort pictures by the pointing word they take.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitu cha ngeli ya ki-vi huonyeshwa kwa hiki; mtu huonyeshwa kwa huyu. (huu)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the one-thing pointing word with a plural noun (watoto huyu).
misconceptions.cause: The child changes the noun but not the pointing word.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Milango ___ imefungwa." with "huu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pair the forms on cards: huyu-hawa, yule-wale, hiki-hivi, hili-haya.
misconceptions.feedback: Watoto ni wengi: watoto hawa. (hii)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses hii for every noun (kitabu hii, mtoto hii), as in town Kiswahili.
misconceptions.cause: Hii is the pointing word heard most in town speech, where the noun class is dropped.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Mkono ___ umeumia." with "hii" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read pairs aloud: kitabu hiki, mtoto huyu, nyumba hii; the child hears the match.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitabu hiki; mtoto huyu; nyumba hii. (huu)
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes near and far pointing words (huyu for someone far away; yule for someone close).

example.question: Mti uko mbali kule. Unasema: Mti ___ ni mrefu.

misconceptions.cause: The child has not linked the forms to distance from the speaker.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mti uko mbali kule. Unasema: Mti ___ ni mrefu." with "huu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Stand near one child and far from another; point and say huyu and yule; then swap places.
misconceptions.feedback: Huyu ni karibu nami; yule ni mbali. (ule)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Mazungumzo ya papo kwa hapo. (Theme 9: Hospitalini)
learning_experiences: kuonyesha ufahamu wa suala lengwa kwa kulieleza ipasavyo,
kusikiliza mgeni mwalikwa au mwalimu, wakizungumza,
kushirikiana na wenzake kusikiliza mazungumzo kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali kuhusu suala lengwa,
kuzungumza kwa kutamka ipasavyo sauti na maneno,

kujieleza kwa ufasaha anapozungumza kwa kutumia lugha inayoeleweka kuhusu suala lengwa, kutumia sauti ipasavyo kwa kuzingatia sauti inayosikika, kasi ya kuzungumza, toni pamoja na udhibiti wa upumuaji na viungo vya kutamka,
kuzungumza akitumia ipasavyo viziada lugha kama vile muktadha wa mazungumzo, ishara za uso, mikono mtuo, mkao wa mwili, utazamaji hadhira kuhusu suala lengwa,
kushirikiana na wenzake kuwasilisha mazungumzo ya papo kwa hapo wakiwa na wenzake, au wakati wa mazungumzo ya hadhara katika tamasha za muziki.
key_inquiry_questions: Tunazingatia mambo gani tunapozungumza papo kwa hapo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi na kuwasilisha hoja zake.

Uraia: mwanafunzi anapotangamana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.

outcomes.text: kuonyesha ufahamu wa suala linalozungumziwa
kuzingatia matamshi bora anapozungumza
kujieleza kwa ufasaha wakati wa kuzungumza, kutumia viziada lugha ipasavyo wakati wa kuzungumza
kufurahia kutoa mazungumzo ya papo kwa hapo ili kujenga ufasaha wa kuzungumza

skills.name: Shiriki mazungumzo kuhusu kumtembelea daktari kwa zamu, kwa matamshi bora na ishara zifaazo
skills.mastery: Takes part in a short conversation about kumtembelea daktari: keeps to the topic, waits for his turn, speaks Kiswahili without English or Sheng words, says sounds clearly and uses gestures that match the words, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Taking part in a short conversation in Grade 1 comes first.
Listening for what others say is half of a conversation.

misconceptions.error: Says something that has nothing to do with the topic.

example.question: Mnazungumza kuhusu kumtembelea daktari. Ni sentensi ipi inafaa?

misconceptions.cause: The child says what is on his mind; he has not learnt that a conversation has a topic everyone keeps to.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mnazungumza kuhusu kumtembelea daktari. Ni sentensi ipi inafaa?" with "Jana nilitazama katuni nzuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Put the topic picture in the middle; before speaking the child points to it.
misconceptions.feedback: Tunazungumza kuhusu kumtembelea daktari; sema jambo kuhusu hilo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Talks over others and does not wait for his turn.
misconceptions.cause: Eagerness: the child fears he will forget his idea.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwenzako anazungumza. Unafanya nini?" with "ninaanza kuzungumza pia" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pass a talking object (a ball): only the one holding it speaks.
misconceptions.feedback: Subiri zamu yako; msikilize mwenzako kwanza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Mixes English or Sheng words into the Kiswahili sentence.
misconceptions.cause: At home and in town the child hears mixed speech and does not know the Kiswahili word.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sema kwa Kiswahili sanifu:" with "Daktari alinipa injection." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a word wall: the English or Sheng word, and its Kiswahili word next to it.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa Kiswahili tunasema: Daktari alinidunga sindano.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses a gesture or face that does not match the words (smiling while giving sad news).

example.question: Unasema "Rafiki yangu ni mgonjwa." Uso wako unaonyesha nini?

misconceptions.cause: The child smiles from shyness or does not link the face to the message.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unasema "Rafiki yangu ni mgonjwa." Uso wako unaonyesha nini?" with "tabasamu kubwa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say one sentence with three faces; the class picks the face that fits.
misconceptions.feedback: Ishara zako zifuate ujumbe wako.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /l/ for /r/ (or /r/ for /l/) while speaking: "rafiki" becomes "lafiki".
misconceptions.cause: Several Kenyan first languages do not separate /l/ and /r/; the home sound carries into Kiswahili.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tamka vizuri: rafiki" with "lafiki" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Practise the pairs with a mirror: the tongue taps for r, it rests for l.
misconceptions.feedback: Tamka "rafiki" kwa /r/: ulimi unagonga mara moja.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kusoma kifungu chepesi cha maneno 47 - 50 na kutambua msamiati wa suala lengwa (dawa, sindano, kitanda) akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutabiri kitakachotokea katika hadithi akizingatia picha kwenye kifungu akiwa peke yake, au na wenzake,
kutabiri ujumbe wa kifungu kwa kutazama picha kwenye kitabu, vifaa vya kidijitali au chati akishirikiana na wenzake,
kueleza mafunzo yanayotokana na kifungu chepesi cha hadithi kuhusu suala lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake,
kuthibitisha utabiri wake kuhusu hadithi baada ya kuisoma,
kutumia msamiati wa suala lengwa ipasavyo katika mawasiliano.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, ukitaka kupata ujumbe kwenye kifungu unazingatia nini?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kujadili ujumbe na mafunzo katika kifungu cha ufahamu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kujifunzia.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomhadithia mzazi au mlezi kifungu alichokisoma shuleni kuhusu suala lengwa.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake wanaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anapowajali wenzake katika kikundi na kuwapa nafasi ya kushiriki.

Elimu ya afya ya kujikinga: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu chepesi cha ufahamu kuhusu suala lengwa.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anaposoma kifungu kuhusu suala lengwa.

skills.name: Soma kifungu chepesi: msamiati, ujumbe, kutabiri na mafunzo
skills.mastery: Reads a short passage on hospitalini, gives the meaning of a theme word from the sentence around it, says the message, predicts what happens next from the clues in the picture and says the lesson, answering from the passage and not from his own life, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: The comprehension questions of Theme 7 come first.
Saying the message of a heard story is the same work.

misconceptions.error: Gives "homa" the meaning of a word that looks or sounds like it.

example.question: Soma: "Amina alikuwa na homa. Mama alimpeleka hospitalini. Daktari alimpima na kumpa dawa. Baada ya siku tatu, Amina alipona." Neno "homa" lina maana gani?
example.correct_answer: ugonjwa wa mwili kuwa na joto jingi

misconceptions.cause: The child matches the word to a known one by its look instead of reading the sentence around it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Soma: "Amina alikuwa na homa. Mama alimpeleka hospitalini. Daktari alimpima na kumpa dawa. Baada ya siku tatu, Amina alipona." Neno "homa" lina maana gani?" with "hema" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Cover the word; the child says what word would fit the sentence, then uncovers it.
misconceptions.feedback: Katika kifungu, "homa" ni ugonjwa wa mwili kuwa na joto jingi.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives one detail of the passage as its message.

example.question: Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?
example.correct_answer: Tukiugua twende hospitalini mapema tupate matibabu.

misconceptions.cause: The detail is what the child remembers best; he has not been asked what the writer wants us to know.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ujumbe wa kifungu ni upi?" with "Amina alienda hospitalini." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask two questions side by side: "Nini kilitokea?" and "Kifungu kinatuambia nini?"
misconceptions.feedback: Hilo ni tukio moja. Ujumbe ni: Tukiugua twende hospitalini mapema tupate matibabu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Predicts something the passage gives no clue for, without looking at the picture.

example.question: Picha inaonyesha Amina akibeba begi la shule asubuhi. Atafanya nini?

misconceptions.cause: Prediction is taken as free imagination; the child has not been shown that clues in the text and picture point the way.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Picha inaonyesha Amina akibeba begi la shule asubuhi. Atafanya nini?" with "Atarudi hospitalini." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the clue words and point at the picture; the guess must fit them.
misconceptions.feedback: Tabiri kwa kutumia dalili za picha na za kifungu: Atarudi shuleni.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Retells what happened when asked for the lesson.

example.question: Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?
example.correct_answer: Tunapaswa kumeza dawa kama daktari anavyoagiza.

misconceptions.cause: The lesson question sounds like a what-happened question to the child.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Tunajifunza nini kutokana na kifungu?" with "Daktari alimpima Amina." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Start the answer with "Tunajifunza kwamba tunapaswa..."
misconceptions.feedback: Funzo ni: Tunapaswa kumeza dawa kama daktari anavyoagiza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Answers from his own life instead of from the passage.

example.question: Amina alipona baada ya siku ngapi?
example.wrong_answer: Mimi nilipona baada ya wiki moja.

misconceptions.cause: The child links the question to what he knows from home and does not check the text.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Amina alipona baada ya siku ngapi?" with "Mimi nilipona baada ya wiki moja." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask the child to point at the line in the passage that gives the answer.
misconceptions.feedback: Jibu liko kwenye kifungu: siku tatu
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua suala la kuandikia kwa kulijadiliana na wenzake darasani,
kutazama picha kuhusu suala lengwa ili kupata habari za kuandikia,
kuwaelekeza wenzake kuhusu atakachoandikia akiwa na wenzake,
kusikiliza wenzake wakieleza kuhusu jambo au suala watakaloandikia kuhusu suala lengwa,
kuandika kifungu kifupi cha sentensi moja au zaidi chenye maelezo yanayoeleweka kuhusu suala lengwa,
kuwawasilishia wenzake kifungu alichoandika ili wakitolee maoni,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu alichokiandika na kumweleza suala aliloandikia ili ampe maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, unaongozwa na mambo gani unapotaka kuandika kifungu?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kujadili kuhusu suala la kuandikia.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapofaulu kutumia kifaa cha kidijitali kuandika kifungu.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika shughuli za kikundi na kujadili suala analoliandikia.
sub_strands.values:
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake na kuheshimu maoni yao.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapowatambua na kuwathamini wenzake wakati wa kushiriki katika shughuli za kuandika.
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya afya ya kujikinga: mwanafunzi anapoandika kifungu kifupi kutokana na mazingira yanayohusu suala lengwa.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anapoandika kuhusu suala lengwa.

outcomes.text: kutambua suala la kuandikia kifungu

skills.name: Andika kifungu kifupi kutokana na picha
skills.mastery: Writes a short paragraph about a picture on hospitalini: a title that fits, sentences in order, one tense, Kiswahili words only, capitals and kikomo in place, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Writing a few sentences from a picture in Grade 1 comes first.
Editing his own writing before the clean copy.

misconceptions.error: Lists the things in the picture (mti, mtoto, mbwa) instead of writing sentences about what is happening.

example.question: Ni kipi ni kifungu kuhusu picha?
example.correct_answer: Mtoto anacheza na mbwa chini ya mti.

misconceptions.cause: Naming pictures was the earlier task; the child has not moved to sentences.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni kipi ni kifungu kuhusu picha?" with "mti. mtoto. mbwa." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Nani? Anafanya nini? Wapi?" for each part of the picture.
misconceptions.feedback: Kifungu kina sentensi zinazoeleza kinachotokea.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes no title, or a title that does not fit the writing.

example.question: Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu hospitalini?

misconceptions.cause: The child thinks the word "insha" or the date is the title.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kichwa kipi kinafaa insha kuhusu hospitalini?" with "Insha" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the finished writing and ask: what is it about in three words?
misconceptions.feedback: Kichwa kinasema insha inahusu nini: Hospitali Yetu.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Joins every sentence with "na halafu", so the writing is one long sentence.

example.question: Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?
example.wrong_answer: Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni.
example.correct_answer: Tuliamka asubuhi. Tulioga, kisha tukaenda sokoni.

misconceptions.cause: Spoken retelling joins events with na halafu; the child writes as he talks.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi limeandikwa vizuri?" with "Tuliamka na halafu tukaoga na halafu tukaenda sokoni." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Give a word bank: kwanza, kisha, baadaye, mwishowe; one per sentence.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia kikomo na maneno kama kisha, baadaye.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Slips from one tense to another in the middle of the writing (past -li- to present -na-, or habitual hu- to past).
misconceptions.cause: The child thinks of the events as he writes and the tense of the moment comes in.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Jana nilienda hospitalini. Daktari ananipima." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline every verb; all the tense markers should match.
misconceptions.feedback: Tumia wakati mmoja katika insha nzima.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Puts English or Sheng words into the Kiswahili writing.
misconceptions.cause: The child does not know the Kiswahili word and fills the gap with the one he knows.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sahihisha:" with "Daktari alinipa tablets." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a word bank of theme words on the board before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Kwa Kiswahili: Daktari alinipa vidonge.
misconceptions.source: English or mother-tongue interference on Kiswahili; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Matumizi ya Vizuri na Vibaya, Polepole na Haraka. (Theme 9: Hospitalini)
learning_experiences: kutambua matumizi ya vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka katika nyenzo kama vile kadi za majina, kapu maneno, mti maneno au chati au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali,
kuigiza vitendo mbalimbali kwa kutumia vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka,
kuandika sentensi zinazojumuisha vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka,
kujaza nafasi kwa kutumia vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka akizingatia suala lengwa kwa kusaidiwa na mwalimu.
key_inquiry_questions: Unatumia maneno yapi kuelezea jinsi watu wanavyofanya vitendo?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhiriki katika kumtungia mwenzake sentensi akitumia vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapoigiza matumizi ya vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka akishirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi sahihi akitumia vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapowasiliana na mzazi au mlezi kwa kutumia vielezi vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka kurejelea vitendo anavyofanya nyumbani.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu mchango wa wenzake katika kazi ya kikundi wanapotungiana sentensi kwa kutumia vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka.
Uwajibikaji: mwanafunzi anapojitolea kuwasiliana na mzazi au mlezi kwa kutumia vielezi vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka kurejelea vitendo anavyofanya nyumbani.
sub_strands.pcis:
Elimu ya afya ya kujikinga: mwanafunzi anapotumia vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka kutunga sentensi akizingatia suala lengwa.
Afya ya mtu binafsi: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi kwa kuzingatia suala lengwa.
sub_strands.links: Mwanafunzi anaweza kuhusisha stadi ya kutumia maneno ya sarufi anayojifunza katika somo la Kiswahili na ujifunzaji wa stadi hiyo katika somo la English Language Activities na Indigenous Language Activities.

outcomes.text: kutambua matumizi yafaayo ya vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka katika kifungu
kutumia vizuri na vibaya, polepole na haraka katika sentensi
kuchangamkia matumizi ya vizuri na vibaya katika kuimarisha mawasiliano

skills.name: Tumia vizuri, vibaya, polepole na haraka katika sentensi
skills.mastery: Says how an action is done with vizuri, vibaya, polepole and haraka after the verb (anatembea polepole), tells them from describing words for things (chakula kizuri), and picks the right word of a pair, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Describing words for things (Theme 6) come before words for how actions are done.
-zuri and -baya (Grade 1) are the stems of vizuri and vibaya.

misconceptions.error: Uses the adjective form for how something is done (anaimba mzuri for anaimba vizuri).
misconceptions.cause: Mzuri is the form the child knows best and he uses it for actions too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Muuguzi anaimba ___ (-zuri)." with "mzuri" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Anaimbaje?" (how) and "Ni mtoto wa namna gani?" (what kind); the first takes vizuri, the second mzuri.
misconceptions.feedback: Kitendo hufanywa vizuri: anaimba vizuri. (vizuri)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks the opposite word of the pair (polepole for haraka, vizuri for vibaya).

example.question: Mgonjwa ana maumivu, anatembea taratibu. Anatembea ___.

misconceptions.cause: The pairs are learnt together and swapped.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mgonjwa ana maumivu, anatembea taratibu. Anatembea ___." with "haraka" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act the pairs: walk polepole, then haraka; the child names each.
misconceptions.feedback: Angalia kitendo tena na uchague neno linalofaa. (polepole)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes the manner word with ki- (kizuri) instead of vi- (vizuri).
misconceptions.cause: Ki-/vi- are heard as one family and the child picks the wrong member.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Jaza: Daktari alimtibu ___ (-zuri)." with "kizuri" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Show that vizuri and vibaya always start with vi- when they tell how something is done.
misconceptions.feedback: Tunasema "vizuri" na "vibaya". (vizuri)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Uses the manner word for a quality of a thing (Chakula ni vizuri for Chakula ni kizuri).
misconceptions.cause: Vizuri is heard everywhere ("ni vizuri") and the child uses it for things too.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Dawa hii ni vizuri." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort sentences: how something is done (vizuri) and what a thing is like (kizuri, mzuri, nzuri).
misconceptions.feedback: Kitu kizuri: chakula ni kizuri; kitendo kizuri: anapika vizuri. (Dawa hii ni nzuri.)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

learning_experiences: kutambua sauti za alfabeti ya Kiswahili katika matini mbalimbali au kifaa cha kidijitali,
kusikiliza maneno yenye silabi za sauti mbalimbali za Kiswahili yakitamkwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au katika kifaa cha kidijitali yanayolenga suala lengwa,
kutamka pamoja na mwalimu maneno aliyosikiliza, kisha ayaseme akishirikiana na wenzake akilenga suala lengwa,
kuunganisha silabi ili kusoma maneno yanayotokana na sauti mbalimbali,
kujirekodi akisoma maneno yenye sauti mbalimbali za Kiswahili na kujisikiliza na wenzake ili kutathmini matamshi bora.
key_inquiry_questions: Unazingatia nini kutamka sauti za Kiswahili kikamilifu?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kutambua na kutamka maneno yenye sauti mbalimbali.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapojirekodi akisoma kifungu na kutambua jinsi alivyotamka sauti mbalimbali.
Kujiamini: mwanafunzi anapotamka ipasavyo sauti mbalimbali za alfabeti ya Kiswahili.
sub_strands.values:
Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutambua na kutamka maneno yenye silabi za sauti mbalimbali za alfabeti ya Kiswahili.
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu matamshi ya wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
sub_strands.pcis:

skills.name: Tambua na utamke silabi za sauti /r/, /l/ katika maneno na sentensi
skills.mastery: Hears and says the target sounds /r/, /l/ in syllables and words (radi, baridi, leo), splits a word into its syllables, and picks or uses a word that carries the sound, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: The sounds of the earlier themes come before all the sounds of the alphabet.
Hearing target syllables in Grade 1.

misconceptions.error: Says /l/ for /r/, so "radi" becomes "ladi".

example.question: Mwalimu anasema "radi". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?

misconceptions.cause: Many Kenyan first languages have no /r/, or do not separate it from /l/; the child puts in the home sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Mwalimu anasema "radi". Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "ladi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say the two side by side, slowly, watching the mouth; the child holds up a card for the sound he hears.
misconceptions.feedback: Sikiliza: "radi" ina sauti /r/, si /l/.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Says /r/ for /l/, so "leo" becomes "reo".
misconceptions.cause: /l/ and /r/ are close; a first language with only one of them puts that one in both places.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno lipi limetamkwa vizuri?" with "reo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Contrast the two with a mirror and a hand before the mouth; the child says which he hears.
misconceptions.feedback: "leo" ina sauti /l/.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Splits "radi" by letters rather than by syllables (each Kiswahili syllable ends in a vowel).
misconceptions.cause: The child has learnt letters one by one and has not been shown that a syllable is a sound that ends in a vowel.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "radi" lina silabi zipi?" with "r-a-d-i" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the word: one clap per vowel; the consonants go with the vowel after them.
misconceptions.feedback: Kila silabi ya Kiswahili huishia kwa irabu: ra-di.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Picks a word with no target sound when asked for one that has it.
misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the first letter or the picture, not at the sound.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni neno lipi lina sauti /r/, /l/?" with "jua" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Underline the target sound in each word on the card before choosing.
misconceptions.feedback: "baridi" ina sauti lengwa; "jua" haina.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Kusoma kwa ufasaha (Theme 10: Hali ya anga)
learning_experiences: kutambua sauti mbalimbali za Kiswahili katika kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia matamshi bora akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa sauti inayosikika akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia kasi ifaayo (maneno 45 kwa dakika na kwa kuzingatia viakifishi) akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusoma kifungu chepesi kuhusu suala lengwa kwa kuzingatia ishara zifaazo akishirikiana na wenzake,
kuwawasilishia hadithi kutoka kwenye kitabu, kifaa cha kidijtali, n.k akishirikiana na wenzake akizingatia sauti inayosikika, matamshi bora, kasi na ishara zifaazo,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu chepesi alichosoma shuleni kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia matamshi bora, sauti inayosikika, kasi na ishara zifaazo.
key_inquiry_questions: Kusoma kifungu kwa ufasaha unazingatia mambo gani?
sub_strands.core_competences:
Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutambua sauti lengwa na kusoma kifungu.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya kidijitali kuwasilisha kifungu cha hadithi.
Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapomsomea mzazi au mlezi kifungu chepesi walichosoma shuleni kuhusu suala lengwa akizingatia matamshi bora, sauti inayosikika, kasi na ishara zifaazo.
sub_strands.values:
Heshima: mwanafunzi anapoheshimu maoni ya wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.
Upendo: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kutekeleza shughuli mbalimbali za ujifunzaji.

skills.name: Soma kifungu chepesi chenye sauti /r/, /l/ kwa matamshi bora, sauti inayosikika, kasi ifaayo na ishara
skills.mastery: Finds the target sounds /r/, /l/ in a short story, reads it aloud with every sound clear, loud enough for the class, at about 45 words a minute, pausing at the koma and kikomo and raising the voice for a question; in the app picks the better reading of a line, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Saying the sounds of the alphabet, r and l among them, comes before reading them aloud.
Reading short sentences aloud in Grade 1.

misconceptions.error: Reads the target word wrongly: "radi" as "ladi".
misconceptions.cause: The child reads the letters with the sounds of his first language, or adds a vowel to break the cluster.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Neno "radi" linasomwa vipi?" with "ladi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Pick out the target words before reading; practise them on cards, then read the passage.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma "radi" kama lilivyoandikwa.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads word by word or syllable by syllable, so the sentence has no meaning when heard.

example.question: Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Mvua kubwa ilinyesha jana usiku."?

misconceptions.cause: The child is still decoding each word; he has not yet read a group of words as one piece.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni usomaji upi ni wa ufasaha: "Mvua kubwa ilinyesha jana usiku."?" with "Mvua ... kubwa ... ilinyesha ... jana ... usiku." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Echo reading: the teacher reads a phrase, the child repeats it in one breath.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma maneno kwa pamoja kama unavyozungumza.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads so softly (or so loudly, shouting) that the class cannot follow.

example.question: Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu
example.correct_answer: ya kusikika na wote darasani, bila kupiga kelele

misconceptions.cause: Shyness, or the belief that reading well means reading loud.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Unaposoma mbele ya darasa, sauti yako inafaa kuwa vipi?" with "ya chini ili nisikosee mbele ya wenzangu" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Stand the reader at the front and a listener at the back: the listener raises a hand when he hears every word.
misconceptions.feedback: Soma kwa sauti inayosikika na wote, bila kupiga kelele.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads as fast as possible and thinks the fastest reader is the best.

example.question: Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?
example.correct_answer: kasi ya kuzungumza, karibu maneno 45 kwa dakika

misconceptions.cause: Reading races in class reward speed; nobody asked whether the listeners understood.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kasi ifaayo ya kusoma kifungu ni ipi?" with "haraka iwezekanavyo" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Time two readings, one very fast and one at speaking pace; the listeners answer one question after each.
misconceptions.feedback: Kasi ifaayo ni ya kuzungumza: si haraka mno, si polepole mno.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Reads a question in the flat voice of a statement and runs on through the koma and kikomo.

example.question: Sentensi "Je, leo kuna jua?" inasomwa vipi?
example.wrong_answer: kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida
example.correct_answer: sauti hupanda mwishoni kwa sababu ni swali

misconceptions.cause: The child looks at the words and not at the marks.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Sentensi "Je, leo kuna jua?" inasomwa vipi?" with "kwa sauti ileile ya sentensi ya kawaida" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Read the same words three ways (. ? !); the child points at the mark that fits each reading; clap at each kikomo.
misconceptions.feedback: Kiulizi (?) hupandisha sauti mwishoni; simama kidogo kwenye koma na kikomo.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

kuandika maneno mepesi ya imla ya silabi tatu kitabuni au katika kifaa cha kidijitali,
kushirikiana na wenzake kuandika maneno mepesi ya silabi tatu,

kuwawasilishia wenzake maneno ya imla ili kuyaandika daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali,
kuandika maneno atakayosomewa na wenzake daftarini au kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali,
kuandika daftarini sentensi sahili walizotunga zinazolenga suala lengwa.

Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi na kuchangia kikamilifu kutambua maneno ya silabi tatu katika sentensi.

Hamu ya ujifunzaji: mwanafunzi anapoandika sentensi za imla akishirikiana na mzazi au mlezi kwenye kifaa cha kidijitali na kuwatumia wenzake mtandaoni.
Ubunifu: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake kuunda sentensi nyepesi.

skills.name: Andika maneno kwa tahajia sahihi
skills.mastery: Writes the words of his own writing (about 20 words) with the right letters: the Kiswahili sound and not the home sound, the nasal kept (nd, mb, ng), long vowels doubled and ng' with its apostrophe, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Spelling in his own sentences (Theme 8) comes first.
Space between words in a sentence.

misconceptions.error: Spells the word with the sound of his first language: "radi" written "ladi".
misconceptions.cause: The child writes as he says the word; if his first language merges the two sounds, the letter is a guess.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "ladi" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Keep a list of the class's hard pairs (l/r, s/sh, z/dh, s/th); say each word slowly before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: Andika "radi" kama linavyotamkwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Drops the nasal: "mvua" written "vua".
misconceptions.cause: The n or m before a consonant is soft and quick; the child does not hear it.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi?" with "vua" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Hum the nasal before the word (mmm-bwa, nnn-dege).
misconceptions.feedback: "mvua" lina sauti ya pua mwanzoni.
misconceptions.source: mother-tongue sound interference common in Kenyan classrooms; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes a long vowel short, so the word changes: "saa" written "sa".

example.question: Andika neno lenye maana ya "kifaa cha kuonyesha wakati".

misconceptions.cause: The child hears the length but does not know it is shown by two letters.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Andika neno lenye maana ya "kifaa cha kuonyesha wakati"." with "sa" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Clap the two vowels as two beats; compare a word with one and two vowels.
misconceptions.feedback: "saa" lina irabu mbili zinazofuatana.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Writes ng' without the apostrophe (ngombe for ng'ombe), or puts it where it does not belong (ng'oma for ngoma).

example.question: Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?

misconceptions.cause: Ng' and ng are two sounds; the apostrophe looks like dirt on the page to the child.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni tahajia ipi sahihi ya mnyama anayetupa maziwa?" with "ngombe" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Say ng'ombe and ngoma: the first has no g sound; mark it with the apostrophe.
misconceptions.feedback: Ng'ombe huandikwa na kibainishi: ng'.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Joins two words into one, or splits one word into two (kwasababu; mwana funzi).
misconceptions.cause: In speech the words run together; the child has not seen each written apart.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Ni lipi sahihi?" with "Nilichelewa kwasababu ya mvua." among the options.
misconceptions.help: Count the words aloud with a finger for each before writing.
misconceptions.feedback: "Kwa sababu" ni maneno mawili.
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

sub_strands.sub_strand: Vinyume vya Vitendo (Theme 10: Hali ya anga)
learning_experiences: kutambua vinyume vya vitendo katika sentensi katika kadi maneno, kapu maneno, kifungu, chati, kitabu au kifaa cha kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake akizingatia suala lengwa,
kusikiliza sentensi zenye vinyume vya vitendo zikisomwa na mwalimu, mgeni mwalikwa au kutoka kwa vifaa vya kidijitali akishirikiana na wenzake,
kusoma vinyume vya vitendo katika sentensi vinavyohusu suala lengwa akishirikiana na wenzake,
kuigiza vinyume vya vitendo vilivyotumiwa katika sentensi akiwa na wenzake,
kukamilisha sentensi akitumia vinyume vya vitendo akishirikiana na wenzake,
kutunga sentensi akitumia vinyume vya vitendo na kuzijadili na wenzake ili kuzitolea maoni,
kumsomea mzazi au mlezi sentensi alizotunga kwa kutumia vinyume vya vitendo ili ampe maoni.
key_inquiry_questions: Je, vinyume vya vitendo huwa vinahusu nini?

Mawasiliano na ushirikiano: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika kikundi kuandika vinyume vya vitendo katika sentensi.
Ujuzi wa kidijitali: mwanafunzi anapotumia vifaa vya teknolojia kusikiliza matumizi ya vinyume vya vitendo.
Ubunifu: anapoigiza matumizi ya vinyume vya vitendo mbalimbali.

Umoja: mwanafunzi anaposhirikiana na wenzake katika shughuli za kikundi.

Elimu ya mazingira na tabia nchi: mwanafunzi anapotunga sentensi akitumia vinyume vya vitendo vinavyohusiana na hali ya anga.

outcomes.text: kutambua vinyume vya vitendo katika sentensi mbalimbali
kutumia majina ya vinyume vya vitendo katika sentensi
kuchangamkia kutumia majina ya vinyume vya vitendo katika mawasiliano ya kila siku

skills.name: Tambua na utumie vinyume vya vitendo katika sentensi
skills.mastery: Gives and uses the opposite action of a verb (fungua - funga, panda - shuka, anza - maliza, keti - simama), not its negative, a word of the same meaning, or a place word, in 8 of 10 new items (the teacher also hears it in class, with the KICD rubric).

prerequisites.reason: Opposite actions of Grade 1 come first.
Knowing the negative lets the child tell it from the opposite.

misconceptions.error: Gives the negative of the verb (hafungui) instead of its opposite action (funga).
misconceptions.cause: The child thinks "opposite" means "not doing it".
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "fungua" (dirisha) ni?" with "usifungue" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act it: fungua the door, then funga it; not doing anything is not the opposite.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha kitendo ni kitendo kingine: fungua - funga. (funga)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Makes an opposite by adding -ua to any verb (keti -> ketua).
misconceptions.cause: Fungua/funga and vaa/vua show a pattern, and the child uses it everywhere.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "simama" ni?" with "simamua" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Sort pairs into two piles: made with -ua (funga-fungua) and different words (keti-simama).
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha keti ni simama. (keti)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a word of the same meaning as the opposite (simama - inuka).
misconceptions.cause: The child knows the words go together but not that they mean the same.
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "anza" ni?" with "zindua" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Act both words: if the action is the same, it is not the opposite.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume ni kitendo kinachopingana. (maliza)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher

misconceptions.error: Gives a place or thing word as the opposite of an action (ingia - nje).
misconceptions.cause: Ingia and nje are heard together in "ingia ndani, toka nje".
misconceptions.reveals: The question "Kinyume cha "panda" (mlima) ni?" with "chini" among the options.
misconceptions.help: Ask "Ni kitendo?" before accepting: the opposite of an action is an action.
misconceptions.feedback: Kinyume cha ingia ni toka. (shuka)
misconceptions.source: common learner error; to confirm by a native Kiswahili teacher
